mapper.select: SELECT row_version FROM shot_audio_cue_allocation_sets WHERE sequence_id = #{sequenceId}
SELECT sequence_id, audio_cue_id, shot_id, audio_cue_row_version FROM shot_audio_cue_allocations WHERE sequence_id = #{sequenceId} ORDER BY audio_cue_id
SELECT sequence_id FROM shot_audio_cue_allocations WHERE audio_cue_id = #{audioCueId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shot_audio_cue_allocation_sets (sequence_id, row_version, updated_at) VALUES (#{sequenceId}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (sequence_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO shot_audio_cue_allocations ( sequence_id, audio_cue_id, shot_id, audio_cue_row_version ) VALUES
(#{allocation.sequenceId}, #{allocation.audioCueId}, #{allocation.shotId}, #{allocation.audioCueRowVersion})
